default.description: Cosmos3 Nano T2V profile for SGLang-Diffusion main 3d540563.
default.notes: 4-GPU CFG parallel plus Ulysses SP for long-video H200 serving; guardrails disabled, no cache. FOUR-GPU CELLS ON THE 2026-09-13 4xB200 RUN ARE 3-4x SLOW AND IT IS NOT SGLANG. All three 4-GPU cases (this one, cosmos3 t2v 189f, cosmos3 i2v 189f) came out 3-4x slower than the SAME case and workload on H100 (07-03, 07-30) and H200 (08-26), three runs that agree with each other inside 2%. Every framework in those cells moved together -- sglang 0.25-0.32x, vLLM-Omni 0.28-0.30x, LightX2V 0.22x -- so the earlier note here calling it a suspected sglang regression was wrong, and is retracted. Nor is it the box: every 2-GPU case in that same run is 1.7-2.6x FASTER than its H200 figure. The discriminator is GPU COUNT, not model and not framework; the original investigation missed it because every image case is 2-GPU. Already eliminated, do not repeat: model unchanged since 2025-08-09, workload identical in both artifacts, warmup scales linearly, attention backend (`fa` is WORSE than the auto-selected dynamic_cudnn_sdpa), interconnect topology (NV18 all-pairs at 53.125 GB/s), offload off with 113 GiB free, MoE boundary 0.875 with both experts resident. Still open: whether a fresh 4xB200 reproduces it. bench-0912 was released and had concurrent-job incidents that day, so contention on GPUs 2-3 would fit exactly (2-GPU work uses 0-1 and was clean) -- but nothing in the artifact records GPU occupancy, so it cannot be checked after the fact. Treat these three cells as suspect until a fresh 4xB200 either reproduces the gap or does not.

blackwell-cudnn.description: Blackwell vLLM-Omni profile for cosmos3_nano_t2v_720p_189f using cuDNN attention.
blackwell-cudnn.notes: Blackwell attention choice, measured on this box 2026-09-12. FLASH_ATTN is a Hopper-only precompiled kernel -- vLLM-Omni refuses it on sm_100 with 'FLASH_ATTN was explicitly selected but is unsupported'. FLASHINFER_ATTN starts but dies under torch.compile on dynamic shapes (`AsPythonConstantNotImplementedError: SymNodeVariable() is not a constant` in the FlashInfer backend's _ensure_plan), observed on qwen-image and cosmos3 t2v; it is fine for the static image cases (zimage, flux), which are deliberately left on it. CUDNN_ATTN is exact softmax, the same precision class as the kernels the other frameworks run here, measured at 2.741s on qwen-image (vs TRTLLM_ATTN 3.274s) and already the backend minimax-h3 serves with on this box.
